visual_action: A montage shows former President Donald Trump with his three Supreme Court appointees. He is seen speaking with Neil Gorsuch, who is then sworn in. Trump then shakes hands with Brett Kavanaugh, who is also sworn in. Finally, Trump walks with Amy Coney Barrett, who is shown taking her oath of office.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: His face appears in every clip of the montage and he is named in the on-screen text: 'This is your reminder that Donald Trump appointed...'

cast.name: Neil Gorsuch
cast.evidence: He is shown speaking with Trump and being sworn in at the beginning of the video.

cast.name: Brett Kavanaugh
cast.evidence: He is shown shaking hands with Trump and being sworn in during the middle of the video.

cast.name: Amy Coney Barrett
cast.evidence: She is shown walking with Trump and being sworn in towards the end of the video.

cast.name: U.S. Supreme Court
cast.evidence: The on-screen text mentions the 'Supreme Court'.

on_screen_text.text: This is your reminder that Donald Trump appointed three conservative justices to the Supreme Court who overturned Roe v. Wade

spoken_summary: The audio consists of a high-pitched, child-like voice repeatedly screaming, "That is not fair!"
audio_music: A dramatic, high-pitched, child-like voice repeatedly screams 'That is not fair!' throughout the video. This meme audio is the dominant sound and is used to signal a sense of outrage and injustice.
editing_pacing: A fast-paced montage of short clips.
cultural_references: The audio features a popular TikTok sound of a child screaming 'That is not fair!', often used to express outrage or injustice.
central_claim: Donald Trump is responsible for the overturning of Roe v. Wade because he appointed the three conservative justices who voted to do so.
intended_effect: To create anger and a sense of injustice towards Donald Trump and remind voters of the consequences of his presidency, particularly regarding abortion rights.
